name: The Arithmetic Laundry
prompt: Hang punched linen strips between red drying posts. A travelling carriage feels the holes with wooden pegs, pushing blue tally beads along a second rail. Operators join two strips with a seam to make a longer calculation.

name: The Counting Canal
prompt: Cut branching channels into a rectangular block of white stone. Black marbles roll through little brass gates and regroup in numbered-looking but unlettered bins. Operators alter a sum by turning the gates with long red handles.

name: The Logic Beehive
prompt: Stack open hexagonal frames into a low honeycomb wall, each cell holding a visible brass lever. A travelling ripple of yellow flags shows one calculation passing across the wall. Mechanics replace a single cell like a beekeeper lifting a frame.

name: Numbers on the Half Shell
prompt: Arrange polished shell-shaped cams around a dark central axle. Clerks select a particular shell from a blue felt tray to change the engine's operation. The output appears as a row of little hammered dimples on a copper strip.

name: The Difference Stair
prompt: Build a staircase of progressively shorter racks of ivory counting rods. At each landing, one team passes the difference between two rows upward using red toggles. At the summit a single brass pointer inscribes a curve in sand.
